title: Benchmarking Task Takeover Across Agent Handoffs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As agents collaborate on longer tasks, responsibility may pass between models before the work is complete. The receiving model must build on prior decisions, observations, and actions while addressing the remaining requirements. Evaluating this transition requires connecting the information preserved at handoff to how the receiver continues the work, a relationship that task-success and memory-retention scores alone do not capture. We introduce the Handoff State Continuity Benchmark (HSC-Bench), comprising 1,039 tasks that evaluate two complementary aspects of task takeover: recovering relevant repository evidence and continuing from established conversational, tool, and file-work state. Comparisons across six receiving models show that structured handoff state improves repository evidence recovery for every model and continuation performance for most models. translated_title: 跨智能体交接的任务接管基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着智能体在更长任务上的协作，责任可能会在工作完成之前于不同模型之间传递。接收模型必须在已有的决策、观察和行动基础上继续工作，同时满足剩余的任务要求。评估这种交接转换需要将交接时保存的信息与接收者如何继续工作联系起来，而这种关系是单纯的任务成功率和记忆保留分数无法捕捉的。我们提出了交接状态连续性基准测试（HSC-Bench），包含1,039个任务，用于评估任务接管的两个互补方面：恢复相关的代码仓库证据，以及从已建立的对话、工具调用和文件工作状态中继续任务。对六个接收模型的比较表明，结构化的交接状态提升了所有模型的仓库证据恢复能力以及大多数模型的任务继续性能。两个评估维度中最强的接收模型有所不同，这表明证据恢复与任务继续是两种不同的能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了HSC-Bench基准测试（含1,039个任务），用于评估智能体任务交接中接收模型恢复仓库证据与继续既有工作状态的能力，发现结构化交接状态能提升所有模型的证据恢复能力和大多数模型的任务继续性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HSC-Bench, a benchmark of 1,039 tasks evaluating how well receiving models recover repository evidence and continue established work state during agent handoffs, showing that structured handoff state improves evidence recovery for all models and continuation performance for most.
